Miau Surveillance

Open-source global surveillance toolkit. Monitor conflicts, track flights, watch live cameras, visualize weather patterns — all from one dashboard. Built by cats in Germany.

▶ Open Dashboard 📊 Full Presentation
Live data from
128 cameras 11 live layers 7k+ traffic cams 51 modules 36 tests

What it does

📷

Live Cameras

128 CCTV feeds across 6 continents. YouTube live embeds. One click to watch any location on Earth.

✈️

Flight Tracking

Real-time ADS-B aircraft positions. Military flight detection. 60-minute movement trails.

🌊

Weather Visualization

Animated jet streams. Wind, temperature, precipitation overlays. Global wind patterns.

🔥

Disaster Monitor

NASA wildfire hotspots. USGS earthquakes. Lightning strikes. All updated live.

🛰

Satellite Tracking

ISS, Hubble, Tiangong. Real-time orbital positions with 90-minute path predictions.

🚦

Traffic Cameras

7,000+ US DOT cameras. M3U8 video streams with in-browser HLS playback.

Why Miau

🆓

Free & Open Source

No API keys needed. No subscriptions. No accounts. MIT licensed.

🐳

One Command Deploy

docker compose up -d. Runs anywhere. Pre-built dist included.

🇩🇪

German Engineering

TypeScript strict mode. 36 automated tests. Zero runtime errors.
